name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 5 visits over 44 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.3 days starting 2025-12-05, at wavelengths from 1.65 to 4.94 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
